name: How should I choose a contractor for interior restoration work?

mainEntity.name: How should I choose a contractor for interior restoration work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a hands-on general contractor who personally supervises job sites and possesses deep craft experience in core trades like framing, drywall, and finish carpentry. Restoration demands careful integration: framing must be plumb, drywall joints must be smooth, and trim must align neatly with old and new construction. Choose a contractor who directly manages licensed trade specialists for plumbing and electrical work so you only have to deal with a single point of contact. Verifying credentials, such as an A+ Better Business Bureau rating and references for similar repair work, ensures accountability from demolition to final paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an experienced, hands-on general contractor with high BBB ratings who provides a single point of contact, manages sub-trades, and excels in framing, drywall, and finish carpentry.
